rows.title: BXPHARMA: Board Meeting schedule under LR 19(1)
rows.body: As per Regulation 19(1) of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (Listing) Regulations, 2015, the Company has informed that a meeting of the Board of Directors will be held on October 28, 2024 at 3:00 PM to consider, among others, audited financial statements of the Company for the year ended June 30, 2024.

rows.title: BXPHARMA: Price Limit Open
rows.body: There will be no price limit on the trading of the shares of the Company today (29.10.2024) following its corporate declaration.

rows.title: BXPHARMA: Dividend Declaration
rows.body: The Board of Directors has recommended 40% Cash Dividend for the year ended June 30, 2024. Date of AGM: 29.12.2024, Time: 10:30 AM, Venue: Virtual Platform. Record Date: 25.11.2024. The Company has also reported consolidated EPS of Tk. 13.07, consolidated NAV per share of Tk. 107.48 and consolidated NOCFPS of Tk. 18.75 for the year ended June 30, 2024 as against Tk. 10.34, Tk. 97.91 and Tk. 13.64 respectively for the year ended June 30, 2023.

rows.title: BXPHARMA: Board Meeting schedule under LR 16(1)
rows.body: As per Regulation 16(1) of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (Listing) Regulations, 2015, the Company has informed that a meeting of the Board of Directors will be held on November 13, 2024 at 4:00 PM to consider, among others, un-audited financial statements of the Company for the First Quarter (Q1) period ended September 30, 2024.

rows.title: BXPHARMA: Regarding dividend declaration of subsidiary companies
rows.body: The company has informed that the Board of Directors of Nuvista Pharma Limited (NPL) recommended 50% cash dividend and the Board of Directors of Synovia Pharma PLC (SPP) recommended 10% cash dividend, two subsidiary companies of Beximco Pharmaceuticals Ltd., for the year 2023-24. The proposed dividends are subject to approval of the shareholders of the respective companies in the forthcoming annual general meeting.

rows.title: BXPHARMA: Q1 Financials
rows.body: (Q1 Un-audited): Consolidated EPS was Tk. 3.77 for July-September 2024 as against Tk. 3.48 for July-September 2023; Consolidated NOCFPS was Tk. 3.80 for July-September 2024 as against Tk. 6.07 for July-September 2023. Consolidated NAV per share was Tk. 111.25 as on September 30, 2024 and Tk. 101.40 as on September 30, 2023.

rows.title: BXPHARMA: Spot News
rows.body: Trading of the shares of the company will be allowed only in the Spot Market and Block transaction will also be settled as per spot settlement cycle with cum benefit from 21.11.2024 to 24.11.2024 and trading of the shares will remain suspended on record date i.e., 25.11.2024.

rows.title: BXPHARMA: Suspension for Record Date
rows.body: Trading of the shares of the company will remain suspended on record date i.e., 25.11.2024.

rows.title: BXPHARMA: Resumption after Record date
rows.body: Trading of the shares of the company will resume on 26.11.2024.

rows.title: BXPHARMA: Credit Rating Result
rows.body: Credit Rating Information and Services Limited (CRISL) has assigned the rating of the Company as "AAA" in the long term and "ST-1" in the short term along with Stable outlook in consideration of its audited financials up to June 30, 2024; unaudited financials up to September 30, 2024 and other relevant quantitative as well as qualitative information up to the date of rating declaration.

rows.title: BXPHARMA: Regarding nomination or appointment of Independent Directors
rows.body: Bangladesh Securities and Exchange Commission (BSEC) has appointed Independent Directors in the Board of the company. To view the information, please visit the following link: https://www.dsebd.org/Annexure/2024/BEXIMCO_BXPHARMA%20_SPCERAMICS_2025.pdf

rows.title: BXPHARMA: Board Meeting schedule under LR 16(1)
rows.body: As per Regulation 16(1) of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (Listing) Regulations, 2015, the Company has informed that a meeting of the Board of Directors will be held on January 28, 2025 at 3:30 PM to consider, among others, un-audited financial statements of the Company for the Second Quarter (Q2) period ended December 31, 2024.

rows.title: BXPHARMA: Q2 Financials
rows.body: (Q2 Un-audited): Consolidated EPS was Tk. 4.10 for October-December 2024 as against Tk. 3.21 for October-December 2023; Consolidated EPS was Tk. 7.87 for July-December 2024 as against Tk. 6.69 for July-December 2023. rows.title: BXPHARMA: Dividend Disbursement
rows.body: The Company has informed that it has disbursed the Cash Dividend for the year ended June 30, 2024 to the respective shareholders.

rows.title: BXPHARMA: Name Change of the Company
rows.body: Dhaka Stock Exchange PLC. (DSE) has approved the proposed name change of the Company. Accordingly, the name of the Company will be 'Beximco Pharmaceuticals PLC.' instead of 'Beximco Pharmaceuticals Limited' with effect from November 10, 2025. Other information (except name) will remain unchanged.
